record.label: Learned-corrector program
record.summary: Per-host retraining, the measured refit ceiling, and the current supplied-host observable reopening are terminal. Full-688 retraining is a defined protocol, not an open scientific leaf: it remains blocked until a new host clears its own accuracy, stability, and deployment gates.
record.terminal_criterion: Terminal when the deployed card's corrector is retrained per-host as standard practice and the new-host tape question is adjudicated with receipts.
